# Multistore - Special characters in URL break your shop in BO and FO

When you set the url of your shop, if you put a special character, like é"'(-è_ç, this will break your shop and you can't acces to it anymore, except if you delete the .htacess files. If you do it, you'll have only one try to modify your url name. You can see it and this video : 

[Untitled_ Mar 2, 2023 4_35 PM.webm](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/100699445/222474998-7db2aba8-c46c-4106-b1f3-be1e957ff5ae.webm)

## Attendu
I wish that my shop will not be broken

a solution possible : 

special character is not allowed for the url

## Étapes
1. Go to BO > Shop Parameters > General 
2. Enable Multistore 
3. Go to Advanced Parameters > Multistore
4.  Clic on "Add a new shop" 
5. Set a "Shop name" and save 
6. Clic on it url link named " Click here to set a URL for this shop. " 
7. On "virtual url" put some special character : "'(-è_çà
8. TAAADAAA, your shop is broken

ÉTAPE 1 LOCALISER. Réponds en JSON : {"keywords": ["...", "..."]} (3 à 8 mots-clés).
